changelog: **Klaviyo leads are unassigned until a rep takes them:** the connector creates the account and the lead person, but no funnel record (`leadOnly` in `createMarketingAccountsBatch`). A new pool on `/sales` (`GET /api/sales/pool`, `POST /api/sales/pool/[id]/claim`, `src/lib/leadClaim.ts`) lets any rep take a lead onto their own book at the first stage; the claim locks the lead's row, so concurrent takers get one record plus a 409. The admin candidate page and list show a marketing lead's real address instead of its `import.local` stand-in, with no activation panel and no password reset (`leadRecord`/`contactEmail` on `GET /api/users/[id]`, `src/lib/leadEmail.ts`). Phones that are not a person's are dropped: the card's ignored numbers (`ExternalConnection.ignoredPhones`) and any number at least 3 different people carry (`phoneKey`/`nonPersonalPhoneKeys`). New **Delete what Klaviyo brought in and read it again** action on the card (`/api/admin/integrations/klaviyo/reset`): it runs the operator rollback for the org's `klaviyo` source, which now also exports `buildPlan`/`wipeAccount` and counts unassigned stand-ins as the account's own. Accounts with a person's work are kept, the admin confirms the exact count, and the profile cursor is reset. New-lead bells go to every admin and rep of the org.

en: Leads from Klaviyo now land in an unassigned pool — each rep takes the ones they want with “Take it”.
Lead pages show the person's real e-mail address, and your company's own phone number is no longer stored as a lead's phone.
New on the Klaviyo card: delete what Klaviyo brought in and import it again cleanly — anything your team already worked on is kept.
tr: Klaviyo'dan gelen lead'ler artık atanmamış bir havuza düşüyor — her temsilci istediğini “Üzerime al” ile alıyor.
Lead sayfaları kişinin gerçek e-posta adresini gösteriyor; şirketinizin kendi telefon numarası artık lead'in telefonu olarak kaydedilmiyor.
Klaviyo kartında yeni: Klaviyo'dan gelenleri silip temiz biçimde yeniden aktarın — ekibinizin üzerinde çalıştığı kayıtlar korunur.
de: Leads aus Klaviyo landen jetzt in einem Pool ohne Zuständigen — jede:r im Vertrieb übernimmt die gewünschten mit „Übernehmen“.
Lead-Seiten zeigen die echte E-Mail-Adresse der Person, und die eigene Telefonnummer Ihres Unternehmens wird nicht mehr als Telefon eines Leads gespeichert.
Neu auf der Klaviyo-Karte: aus Klaviyo Übernommenes löschen und sauber neu einlesen — woran Ihr Team schon gearbeitet hat, bleibt erhalten.
